arxiv-2105-05992.title: Informationally complete POVM-based shadow tomography
arxiv-2105-05992.creator: Atithi Acharya, Siddhartha Saha, Anirvan M. Sengupta
arxiv-2105-05992.description: Abstract Abstract: Recently introduced shadow tomography protocols use ‘classical shadows’ of quantum states to predict many target functions of an unknown quantum state. Unlike full quantum state tomography, shadow tomography does not insist on accurate recovery of the density matrix for high rank mixed states.

arxiv-2108-10713.title: Quantum Field Theory Deserves Extra Help
arxiv-2108-10713.creator: John R. Klauder
arxiv-2108-10713.description: Abstract Today’s quantum field theory (QFT) relies heavenly on canonical quantization (CQ), which fails for φ 4 4 \varphi^{4}_{4} leading only to a “free” result. Affine quantization (AQ), an alternative quantization procedure, leads to a “non-free” result for the same model. Perhaps adding AQ to CQ can improve the quantization of a wide class of problems in QFT.

arxiv-2109-01901.title: The anatomy of Boris type solvers and the Lie operator formalism for deriving large time-step magnetic field integrators
arxiv-2109-01901.creator: Siu A. Chin ∗ and Durward Cator
arxiv-2109-01901.description: Abstract This work gives a Lie operator derivation of various Boris solvers via a detailed study of trajectory errors in a constant magnetic field. These errors in the gyrocenter location and the gyroradius are the foundational basis for why Boris solvers existed, independent of any finite-difference schemes.

arxiv-2304-10715.title: Flares from merged magnetars: their prospects as a new population of gamma-ray counterparts of binary neutron star mergers
arxiv-2304-10715.creator: Shu-Xu Yi, Zhen Zhang, Xilu Wang
arxiv-2304-10715.description: Abstract Long-lived massive magnetars are expected to be remnants of some binary neutron star (BNS) mergers. In this paper, we argue that the magnetic powered flaring activities of these merged magnetars would occur dominantly in their early millisecond-period-spin phase, which is in the timescale of days.

arxiv-2306-17763.title: The dynamics of crack front waves in 3D material failure
arxiv-2306-17763.creator: Sanhita Das, Yuri Lubomirsky, Eran Bouchbinder
arxiv-2306-17763.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sanhita Das, Yuri Lubomirsky, Eran Bouchbinder. Crack front waves (FWs) are dynamic objects that propagate along moving crack fronts in 3D materials. We study FW dynamics in the framework of a 3D phase-field framework that features a rate-dependent fracture energy Γ ⁡ ( v ) \Gamma(v) ( v v is the crack propagation velocity) and intrinsic lengthscales, and quantitatively reproduces the high-speed oscillatory instability in the quasi-2D limit.

arxiv-2307-04296.title: K-Space-Aware Cross-Modality Score for Quality Assessment of Synthesized Neuroimages
arxiv-2307-04296.creator: Guoyang Xie, Jinbao Wang, Yawen Huang, Jiayi Lyu, Feng Zheng, Yefeng Zheng, Yaochu Jin
arxiv-2307-04296.description: Abstract The problem of how to assess cross-modality medical image synthesis has been largely unexplored. The most used measures like PSNR and SSIM focus on analyzing the structural features but neglect the crucial lesion location and fundamental k-space speciality of medical images. To overcome this problem, we propose a new metric K-CROSS to spur progress on this challenging problem.

arxiv-2412-11750.title: Common Ground, Diverse Roots: The Difficulty of Classifying Common Examples in Spanish Varieties
arxiv-2412-11750.creator: Javier A. Lopetegui, Arij RiabiDjamé SeddahINRIA Paris, France
arxiv-2412-11750.description: Abstract Variations in languages across geographic regions or cultures are crucial to address to avoid biases in NLP systems designed for culturally sensitive tasks, such as hate speech detection or dialog with conversational agents. In languages such as Spanish, where varieties can significantly overlap, many examples can be valid across them, which we refer to as common examples.

arxiv-2412-16676.title: A class of forward-backward diffusion equations for multiplicative noise removal
arxiv-2412-16676.creator: Yihui Tong, Wenjie Liu, Zhichang Guo, Wenjuan Yao
arxiv-2412-16676.description: Abstract . This paper investigates a class of degenerate forward-backward diffusion equations with a nonlinear source term, proposed as a model for removing multiplicative noise in images. Based on Rothe’s method, the relaxation theorem, and Schauder’s fixed-point theorem, we establish the existence of Young measure solutions for the corresponding initial boundary problem.

arxiv-2504-03894.title: Leveraging Gait Patterns as Biomarkers: An attention-guided Deep Multiple Instance Learning Network for Scoliosis Classification
arxiv-2504-03894.creator: Haiqing Li, Yuzhi Guo, Feng Jiang, Qifeng Zhou, Hehuan Ma, Junzhou Huang
arxiv-2504-03894.description: Abstract Scoliosis is a spinal curvature disorder that is difficult to detect early and can compress the chest cavity, impacting respiratory function and cardiac health. Especially for adolescents, delayed detection and treatment result in worsening compression. Traditional scoliosis detection methods heavily rely on clinical expertise, and X-ray imaging poses radiation risks, limiting large-scale early screening.

arxiv-2508-07630.title: InterChart : Benchmarking Visual Reasoning Across Decomposed and Distributed Chart Information
arxiv-2508-07630.creator: Anirudh Iyengar Kaniyar Narayana Iyengar, Srija Mukhopadhyay Adnan Qidwai , Shubhankar Singh , Dan Roth , Vivek Gupta [2pt] Arizona State University IIIT, Hyderabad Mercer Mettl University of Pennsylvania[0pt] akaniyar@asu.edu, srija.mukhopadhyay@research.iiit.ac.in, adnan.qidwai@students.iiit.ac.in
arxiv-2508-07630.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anirudh Iyengar Kaniyar Narayana Iyengar, Srija Mukhopadhyay Adnan Qidwai , Shubhankar Singh , Dan Roth , Vivek Gupta [2pt] Arizona State University IIIT, Hyderabad Mercer Mettl University of Pennsylvania[0pt] akaniyar@asu.edu, srija.mukhopadhyay@research.iiit.ac.in, adnan.qidwai@students.iiit.ac.in. We introduce InterChart , a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates how well vision-language models (VLMs) reason across multiple related charts, a task central to real-world applications such as scientific reporting, financial analysis, and public policy dashboards.

arxiv-2508-18090.title: Named Entity Recognition of Historical Text via Large Language Model
arxiv-2508-18090.creator: Shibingfeng Zhang, Giovanni Colavizza
arxiv-2508-18090.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable versatility across a wide range of natural language processing tasks and domains. One such task is Named Entity Recognition (NER), which involves identifying and classifying proper names in text, such as people, organizations, locations, dates, and other specific entities.

arxiv-2512-20728.title: Spacetime-spectral analysis of flowfields
arxiv-2512-20728.creator: Vilas J. Shinde
arxiv-2512-20728.description: Abstract The classical Fourier analysis of a time signal, in the discrete sense, provides the frequency content of signal under the assumption of periodicity. Although the original signal can be exactly recovered using an inverse transform, the time dependence of the spectrum remains inaccessible.

arxiv-2605-07508.title: Measurements of the micro-spill structure of medical cyclotron and synchrotron beams and its impact on pulse pileup
arxiv-2605-07508.creator: Albert Hirtl

pmc-10736946.title: MAKING OLDER ADULT FALL PREVENTION A ROUTINE PART OF HEALTHCARE IN TRIBAL CLINICAL SETTINGS
pmc-10736946.creator: Gwen Bergen, Leo Egashira, Myra Parker, Shakiera Causey, Yara Haddad
pmc-10736946.description: Over one-third of American Indian and Alaska Native (AI/AN) elders (age 65+) report falling annually. This percentage is higher compared to other race/ethnic groups except for White non-Hispanic older adults. CDC’s Stopping Elderly Accidents, Deaths, and Injuries (STEADI) initiative provides guidance for making elder fall prevention a routine part of clinical care.

pmc-11671686.title: Prognostic and Predictive Biomarkers of Oligometastatic NSCLC: New Insights and Clinical Applications
pmc-11671686.creator: Mandy Jongbloed, Martina Bortolot, Leonard Wee, Jarno W.J. Huijs, Murillo Bellezo, Rianne D.W. Vaes, Frank Aboubakar Nana, Koen J. Hartemink, Dirk K.M. De Ruysscher, Lizza E.L. Hendriks
pmc-11671686.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This review discusses the current data on predictive and prognostic biomarkers in oligometastatic NSCLC and discusses whether biomarkers identified in other stages and widespread metastatic disease can be extrapolated to the oligometastatic disease (OMD) setting. Research is underway to explore the prognostic and predictive value of biological attributes of tumor tissue, circulating cells, the tumor microenvironment, and imaging findings as biomarkers of oligometastatic NSCLC.

pmc-12653498.title: Old Drugs, New Battles: Unleashing Repurposed Drug Classes in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Treatment
pmc-12653498.creator: Vania S Tshimweneka, Thandi V Mhlanga, Mi Kyung Park
pmc-12653498.description: Cancer remains a major global health challenge, with triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) representing one of the most aggressive and difficult-to-treat subtypes, characterized by poor prognosis and limited therapeutic options. Current treatments, including chemotherapy, are hindered by high recurrence rates, drug resistance, and severe side effects, highlighting the urgent need for novel therapeutic strategies to address these challenges.

pmc-13223834.title: Dietary fat type modulates fatty acid digestibility, de novo lipogenesis, and energy expenditure in broiler chickens
pmc-13223834.creator: Sasiphan Wongsuthavas, Metha Wanapat, Chalermpon Yuangklang, Kraisit Vasupen, Wannaree Wongtrairat, Benjamad Khonkhaeng, Jiravan Khotsakdee, Anton C Beynen
pmc-13223834.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study tested the hypothesis that krabok oil (KO), a medium-chain saturated fatty acid (MCT)-rich fat source, would mimic the growth and carcass fat reducing effects of polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA)-rich soybean oil (SBO) in broiler chickens. Forty-five 7-day-old Arbor Acres broilers were randomly assigned to three dietary treatments tallow (T), SBO, and KO with 15 birds per treatment (n = 15) serving as individual replicates.

pmc-13334217.title: Talking to the Brain: Using Large Language Models as Proxies to Model Brain Semantic Features
pmc-13334217.creator: Xin Liu, Ziyue Zhang, Jingxin Nie
pmc-13334217.description: Utilizing naturalistic stimuli while maintaining experimental rigor presents a significant challenge in neuroimaging research, primarily due to the complexities of annotation and high‐dimensional analysis. To address this, we introduce a novel paradigm that leverages multimodal large language models (LLMs) as high‐throughput, automated annotation tools to extract human‐understandable semantic features.

pmc-13501116.title: Transcriptional Profiling of Growth Hormone–Secreting Pituitary Adenoma Stem‐Like Cells: Unveiling the Significant Role of CXCR4 in Tumorigenesis and Clinical Applications
pmc-13501116.creator: LinHao Yuan, Hao Yang, BaoWang Li, Huimin Sui, Peiliang Li, Xu Wang, Jiang Li, Guijun Jia, Zhaohui Zhu, Deling Li, Wang Jia, Peng Kang
pmc-13501116.description: Growth hormone–secreting pituitary adenoma (GHPA) can cause excessive growth hormone production, which can lead to clinical symptoms such as acromegaly. Tumor stem cells (TSCs) are postulated to play a significant role in the development of GHPA. We performed RNA sequencing on human pituitary adenoma stem‐like cells (hPASCs) and matched bulk tumors to map a differentiation protein–protein interaction (PPI) network.

pmc-13651291.title: Medical insurance scheme and out-of-pocket medical burden among Chinese adults: repeated cross-sectional evidence from CFPS 2016–2022
pmc-13651291.creator: Xingxing Ren, Yu Hao, Sucheng Mu, Chaoyuan Jin
pmc-13651291.description: BackgroundChina has achieved broad health insurance coverage, but financial protection may still differ across schemes. We assessed whether insurance scheme was associated with out-of-pocket medical burden among Chinese adults.MethodsWe analyzed repeated cross-sectional adult person-wave data from the China Family Panel Studies for 2016, 2018, 2020, and 2022.
